sloka: आयस्ते विपुल: कच्चित् कच्चिदल्पतरो व्यय: ।अपात्रेषु न ते कच्चित्कोशो गच्छति राघव ॥ २.१००.५५॥
transliteration: āyaste vipula: kaccit kaccidalpataro vyaya: ।apātreṣu na te kaccitkośo gacchati rāghava ॥ 2.100.55॥

translations.english: I trust, you are spending only on gods, ancestors, brahmins, guests, warriors and hosts of friends.
